contents.text: فحلها مع ذلك وأرسلها ومن[ي ?]

contents.text: بأي وجه انتفاعكم وإلى درع [?] أثوفاكم[?] / مالي سوى عفوك يا سيدي فليس للمذنب إلا كرم
contents.note: two lines of verse, line 11 doubtful (central words 'wa-ila dir' ... ), line 12 clear: 'I have nothing but your pardon, my lord; the sinner has nothing but generosity'. Line 12 ends 'illa karam'; probably the plaintext of the block (a poem of apology, as on f. 94r)

correspondents.translit: sayyidi: no name, no patronymic, no formula

technique_remarks: none stated; 'ma' dhalika' = 'with that' links the block to the previous exchange (f. 95v); 'irtijalan' = the plaintext was improvised by the other party
plaintext_for: lines 11-12 are presumably the plaintext of the 8-line block (lines 2-9); the compiler gives no halaltuhu but 'fa-hallaha ma' dhalika wa-arsalaha'
dating: no year, no named person, no formula
certainty: high for line 1 and line 12; medium for line 10; low for line 11; medium for sign counts (counted from 2x crop, sign shapes small)

contents.text: خلاصة الجوهر كنتم لذا من در[?] [نحوا ?] أنفاكم / فلا تضيعوا عبدكم وارحموا أحبابكم الرب وأبقاكم / الأحسن تكرير حرف الجر فالأولى أن يقال بأي وجه / وبأي درع ولكنه ورد كقول الشاعر وهو من أبيات / كتاب سيبويه / فاليوم قربت تهجونا وتشتمنا فاذهب فما بك والأيام من / عجب / ومثله قراءة حمزة في قوله تعالى واتقوا الله الذي / تساءلون به والأرحام بالجر وكذلك الأكثر جائز[?] كقول الشاع[ر] / وما بالي إذا ما كنت جارتنا أن لا يجاورنا الآ[?] ك [?] د ا ر[?] / وكتب لي المقر[?] المخدومي العلائي بسط الله ظلاله / مترجما جواب الأبيات المتقدمة وأرسله صحبتها من السرحة[?] / لمباركه بمنزلة رياض[?] وجبر وتصدق ولحسن ونلطف[?]
contents.note: no cipher on this page. Lines 1-2: end of the verses begun on f. 96r (with a plea 'do not neglect your slave, have mercy on your friends'); lines 3-9: grammatical note on repeating the preposition (bi-ayyi wajh / wa-bi-ayyi dar'): it is better to repeat the particle of jarr, 'but it occurs [without] as in the poet's line, which is among the verses of the Kitab of Sibawayh' [quotation: fa-l-yawma qarrabta tahjuna wa-tashtumuna fa-dhhab fa-ma bika wa-l-ayyami min 'ajab], and likewise the reading of Hamza in the verse 'wa-ttaqu Llaha lladhi tasa'aluna bihi wa-l-arhami' (Qur'an 4:1, genitive); line 10 another verse (as read, doubtful); lines 11-13: 'and al-maqarr al-makhdumi al-'Ala'i, basata Allah zilalahu, wrote to me in cipher (mutarjaman) the answer to the above verses and sent it together with them from al-Sarha [?], ...' ; line 13 doubtful

correspondents.arabic: المقر[?] المخدومي العلائي بسط الله ظلاله
correspondents.translit: al-maqarr [reading of the title doubtful] al-makhdumi al-'Ala'i, basata Allah zilalahu (alive); no personal name, no patronymic. Same person as 'al-makhdum al-'Ala'i' of f. 93r. He writes in cipher a reply to the preceding verses. Place name 'al-Sarha' (doubtful reading)
Sibawayh (author of the Kitab) and Hamza (Qur'an reader), cited as grammatical authorities, no formula

technique_remarks: no cipher technique; 'mutarjaman' = in cipher. The grammatical discussion concerns repeating the preposition in the verse of apology (f. 96r line 11 'bi-ayyi wajh ... wa-ila ...')
plaintext_for: none on this page (no cipher). The reply 'mutarjaman' announced in lines 11-12 is a cipher block that should open f. 97r (not seen by this pass)
dating: no year, no Hijri date. Named: al-Makhdumi al-'Ala'i with 'basata Allah zilalahu' (alive, no patronymic); Sibawayh and Hamza only as authorities (no formula written)
certainty: medium for lines 2-9; low for line 1, 10, 13; low for the reading of the title in line 11 ('al-maqarr' vs 'al-mufarrir') and of the place 'al-Sarha'
